title: The Hearthlands' Tally-Sticks quest (collect Sela's stick, the almonry's tally, and the widow's family stick, 3/3) never connects to an action that settles the Hunger Barn's grief -- the grief's own 'weigh' text only ever lists the bargain routes (persuade/force/alter/pay) and the burn route; there is no 'read the sticks aloud' option anywhere, even though Sela's own line implies one should exist ('A bargain isn't a reading. The sticks stay unread... I notice the difference').
where: Hearthlands / The Hunger Barn, 'weigh what this grief asks'
